messages:
Maya Liu: ap-south2 (apso2) GPU cluster bootstrapped — 6x A100 nodes, storage PVs bound, k8s control-plane healthy. Hooked up to prod-vpc peering but note egress is gated.
Maya Liu: Runbook & checklist: https://docs.internal/redwood/runbooks/apso2-bootstrap (please read before claiming oncall)
Omar Reed: Thanks Maya. Can you drop a short handoff checklist here (pager rules, who owns initial triage, any quirks to watch)?
Maya Liu: Sure. Short handoff summary:
- PagerDuty service: "apso2-gpu" (PDSV-8342)
- Pager thresholds: GPU memory >= 92% for 3m -> page, GPU temp >= 90C for 2m -> page, node disk latency p99 > 200ms -> page
- Escalation path: primary oncall -> Priya Singh (infra secondary, 20m) -> Kevin Tran (infra lead, 45m)
- Vault: routing key at secret/pager/apso2, rollback key at secret/pager/apso2-roll
- Test page performed 2026-03-12

Luis Ortega: Note on routing: PD -> SMS/mobile for primary, mirrored to #eng-oncall for context. Critical sevs also cross-post to #eng-sre-alerts. We set a 10m non-critical timeout to avoid daytime noise.

Ops-Bot: PagerPolicy applied: apso2-gpu thresholds {gpu_mem_pct:92, gpu_temp_c:90, disk_p99_ms:200}

Priya Singh: Quick networking caveat: cluster nodes sit in a private subnet with no full internet by default. Model downloads must go via our model-cache endpoint or approved NAT gateway. If tasks fail on pulling images, check NAT status and fw rule fw-apso2-model-fetch.

Maya Liu: Ownership matrix (excerpt):
- First responder: eng-oncall rotation
- Secondary: Priya Singh (20m)
- Tertiary: Kevin Tran (45m)
- PD Sev definitions and runbook playbooks linked in runbook

Omar Reed: Cost controls? Autoscaler limits? Any burst caps?

Kevin Tran: Autoscaler config: min 2 nodes, target 6, max 12; burst pool cap at 16 GPUs (reserved). Budget monitor configured: if weekly spend > budget by 25% -> alert to #finance-ops and page infra owners.

Luis Ortega: Access note: PD routing key rotates monthly. Team leads have decrypt access to secret/pager/apso2. Ops playbook includes steps to rekey if needed.

Maya Liu: Handoff validation steps (do these after claiming ownership):
1) Trigger PD test: curl -X POST https://events.pagerduty.com/v2/enqueue -d '{"routing_key":"<key>","event_action":"trigger","payload":{"summary":"apso2 test"}}'
2) Deploy a small mem-hog in staging namespace to simulate GPU OOM (use limits to avoid impacting prod)
3) Check Grafana dashboard "AP-SOUTH2 Cluster" for GPU mem, temp, and disk p99; verify alerts appear
4) Validate SLO traces tag service=apso2-runtime in Jaeger

Priya Singh: I'll claim oncall next rotation and run a 30m training: runbook walk-through, PD playbook, and test pages. Scheduled Thu 11am IST — calendar invite in runbook.

Maya Liu: Training checklist: demo rolling node replacement, driver image rollback, and safe drain. Add snippet for replace/driver update:
```
# mark node out
kubectl cordon <node-name>
kubectl drain <node-name> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
# update driver DaemonSet
kubectl set image daemonset/gpu-drivers gpu-driver=registry.redwood/gpu-driver:v2.0.1
# uncordon after checks
kubectl uncordon <node-name>
```

Omar Reed: What about fallback if PD or SMS fails?

Luis Ortega: Fallback: Slack bridge bot @ops-bot will trigger secondary SMS gateway. Phone escalation list in runbook (encrypted). Also tested the bridge last week.

Maya Liu: Known issues from bootstrap run:
- One host (node-07) showed ECC errors on one GPU; we replaced hardware and ran burn-in. Tag: hw-replaced-2026-03-11
- CSI attach occasionally returned 500s under high attach churn; we increased attach timeout and added retry logic in provisioner

Oncall Rotation (bot): Oncall claimed: Priya Singh from 2026-03-14 to 2026-03-21. Training scheduled.

Priya Singh: ACK — will run tests during training and post back with results and a recorded session link. :thumbsup:

Ops-Bot: Handoff recorded: apso2-transfer by Maya Liu @ 2026-03-12T09:08:00Z
